about_the_game:
Go beyond the hotel doors and explore the massive universe of Hotel Galactic in this beautifully illustrated 90+ page digital artbook. Bursting with hand-drawn art and vibrant worldbuilding, this companion book dives into the heart of the Celestar Galaxy and its inhabitants.

Inside you'll find:

  • Concept art and final designs spanning the entire development of the game,

  • Pages dedicated to species, characters, locations, the hotel, food, and more,

  • Insider commentary from the devs and artists, offering creative insights, design decisions, and fun trivia,

  • A behind-the-scenes look at how our beautifully animated trailers were produced,

  • An intimate guided tour through Imoshima Island, Satori Island, and beyond
